projectiles.name: 3BM9 (125 mm APFSDS, steel rod)

projectiles.notes: HE-fragmentation warhead of about 9 kg. Filler: about 1.6 kg of an RDX/aluminium mix (A-IX-2), modelled with the H-6 table; filler mass, impact speed and mass after burnout are estimates.

projectiles.name: AGM-176 Griffin
projectiles.notes: Blast-fragmentation warhead of about 5.9 kg behind the seeker. Filler: about 1.5 kg of Composition B; the model fills the whole case cavity (about 3 kg). Impact speed and mass after burnout are estimates.

projectiles.name: AGM-114M Hellfire II
sources: FAS Military Analysis Network: AGM-114 Hellfire
projectiles.notes: Blast-fragmentation warhead behind the seeker for buildings and light vehicles. Filler: about 3.7 kg of PBXN-109, modelled with the H-6 table, filling the 120 mm steel case; the rest of the mass is the motor tube and its remaining propellant. Filler, impact speed and mass after burnout are estimates.
